description: This file implements WebAuthn-based security key registration and encryption key derivation functions for the Notesnook project.

methods.name: registerSecurityKey
methods.description: Registers a new security key using WebAuthn API, returning credential details including salts and transports.

methods.name: getEncryptionKey
methods.description: Derives an encryption key using WebAuthn PRF extension and HKDF, based on provided credential info.
